title: resource
description: One resource in full, from describe, for any kind but Block, which has its own schema: where it is, the file as written and the resource as read, so a reader can show the resource or the file it comes from. The answer's kind is always Resource and data.kind says which kind the resource is, so a design kind named like an answer never points a reader to the wrong schema.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Resource, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The resource: its kind, id, file, the file's text and the resource as read.

kind.description: The resource's kind, a built-in kind or one the design declares; never Block, which block.schema.json answers.

id.description: The resource's id. An id is unique only within a kind, so kind and id together name it.

path.description: The file, relative to the design, so a reader can open it or point to it.

text.description: The whole file in the form this contract reads, every document in it, since writing back one document of a file would drop the rest. A file in an older form is answered upgraded, so its bytes on disk come from describe --raw.

document.description: The resource as read from its file, the same shape describe design gives for each document, so a reader draws it without parsing text.
